personality: 1 iOS-Native structure with 6 Glass / Luxe premium finishes
personality_one_liner: A premium, feminine, and elegant financial command center that feels like a modern luxury beauty brand meets a high-end fintech app.

spacing.rule: Generous, thumb-friendly padding. Avoid dense data views; utilize whitespace to make the app feel approachable and high-end.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar and header over scrolling content.
Apply glass overlay on the hero balance card over the abstract pink gradient background.
Use glass for floating action buttons (FAB) layered over lists.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or form inputs.
Do not use glass effects without a properly tinted underlying base to ensure text readability.

screens.name: Dashboard (Inicio)
screens.purpose: A welcoming, high-end overview of available money, income/expenses, and the 50/30/20 budget method progress.

states.loading: Centered soft pink spinner with elegant fade-in.
states.empty: Should not be entirely empty, but 0 balance shows a motivational soft message like '¡Comienza tu viaje financiero hoy! 💗'.
states.error: Soft error toast with a retry button in brandPrimary.

screens.layout: Top: Glassmorphic sticky header greeting the user. Hero: A large, beautifully rounded card featuring the total balance over a subtle pink/rose-gold abstract gradient background, with glassmorphism overlay. Below hero: A 3-column pill/chip layout for the 50/30/20 budget breakdown (Necesidades, Gustos, Ahorro) with mini progress bars. Bottom: Contextual financial tip card ('Vas muy bien este mes 💗').

screens.name: Movimientos
screens.purpose: A clear, easily scannable list of income and expenses organized by month.

states.loading: Skeleton rows with a soft shimmer.
states.empty: Illustration of an elegant empty wallet with text 'Aún no hay movimientos este mes'.

screens.layout: Top: A horizontal, scrollable month/year selector (Enero 2026, Febrero 2026) acting as a sticky filter. Below: Search bar (rounded pill). Main content: Transaction list grouped by date. Rows use clear emojis (🏠, 🍔) inside a brandTertiary tinted circle, transaction name, and amount formatted in COP ($4.000.000). Green for income, dark text for expenses.

screens.name: Metas (Goals)
screens.purpose: Visual, highly motivating grid showing progress toward savings goals.

states.empty: Illustration of a shopping bag with text '¿Qué sueño quieres cumplir? Crea tu primera meta'.

screens.layout: 2-column grid layout with generous gap. Each card represents a goal (Viaje ✈️, iPhone 📱) featuring a circular progress ring, the total accumulated, and the target amount. Cards should have soft shadows and white backgrounds.

screens.name: Perfil
screens.purpose: Personalized user settings, statistics, and financial calendar.
screens.layout: Top: Hero section with a luxury lifestyle portrait as the background banner, layered with a gradient-to-dark scrim, and the user's avatar/initials layered on top. List below: Stats (Pie charts/line charts), Financial Calendar, and App Settings (Dark Mode toggle). List rows should have a trailing chevron.

screens.name: Add Transaction (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Frictionless, thumb-friendly entry for adding income or expenses.

states.error: Validation errors below inputs in error color.

screens.layout: Invoked via a central FAB in the bottom tab bar. Full-width, large inputs. A toggle for Ingreso/Gasto. Horizontal scrollable list of category chips (Vivienda, Comida, etc.). A massive, sticky primary CTA at the bottom ('Guardar').

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Soft pink and peach abstract background

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT DARK MODE strictly using the tokens provided in 'dark_mode_colors_instruction'. Avoid pure black; use deep plum/charcoal tones.
No indigo, blue, or generic purple gradients allowed. Stick strictly to the elegant hot pink, soft rose, and blush cream palette.
Typography: Use Fraunces for large display headings (balances, screen titles) and Manrope for all UI text, labels, and lists. Never use bold weights for Fraunces; use size for hierarchy.
Format all currency in COP with dots as thousand separators (e.g., $4.000.000).
Use emojis as category icons (🏠, 🍔, 🚗) placed inside a circular container tinted with brandTertiary, to keep the UI friendly for non-tech-savvy users.
The central Add Transaction FAB should use a glassmorphic layer and sit prominently in the bottom tab bar.
Always apply a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over background images (e.g., hero card, profile banner) before placing text on top.
Ensure all buttons are massive and thumb-friendly (min 56pt height) to accommodate the iPhone 16 Pro Max screen size.
Add contextual success toasts with emojis (e.g., '💗 Gasto guardado') using the toast pattern described in the guidelines.
